lenses: Runner refuses inherited DATABASE_URL and JWT_SECRET to avoid accidental credential/target reuse.
Runner requires SMARTAIHUB_R5_DATABASE_URL and an explicit disposable-database confirmation flag.
Runner and test both enforce loopback host plus the exact miniapp_r5_test database name.
JWT signing dependency receives only a fixed synthetic test secret inside the child process.
No historical migration journal, production endpoint, external provider, or production secret is used.
Tenant, user, App, Project, persona, conversation, and memory fixtures use unique synthetic IDs.
Project A read checks active tenant/user/App/project binding and current membership through the actual receipt authority.
Membership and App binding revocations are re-read before each Project-aware memory query.
Conversation retarget and NO_PROJECT use persisted conversation state and require global-only prompt content.
Cleanup is scoped to the test's unique synthetic tenant/user rows; no broad truncate or database reset occurs.
securityReview.durableProjectWrites: not invoked; production durable Project writes remain DENY

limitations: This proves the tested persisted App/Project prompt path for the synthetic server-side TrustedAppRuntimeContext; it does not prove a production ingress assertion producer or deployed ingress provenance.
App-private memory isolation remains unproven because current memory storage lacks an authoritative appId dimension; do not mark T-01 PASS.
These direct scenarios are evidence slices for T-02/T-03/T-04/T-05/T-18, not closure of the complete SPEC-269 T-01–T-23 matrix.
SPEC-271 WP2B receipt ownership, worker execution/recovery, scheduler useful-work completion, leases, and protected Runner binding remain untested.
